name: ANNUAL_PANEL_1Y

feature_cols: Depreciation / Amortisation (net of transfer from revaluation reserves)
Paid up equity capital (net of forfeited equity capital)
Long term borrowings excl current portion
Current assets (incl. short term investments, loans & advances)
Short term trade receivables & bills receivable
Net cash flow from operating activities
Net cash inflow or (outflow) from investing activities
Net cash inflow or (outflow) from financing activities
Cash (outflow) due to purchase of fixed assets
Cash and cash equivalents as at the end of the year
Total Outside Liabilities to Tangible Net Worth (times)
Short term int exp as % of avg short term borrowings
Return on net worth (Return on Equity)
Operating profit margin of non-financial companies
Cash profit as % of total income
Change in Profits after Tax net of Prior period & Extra-ordinary items

notes: Built from data/ml_lab/datasets/annual_panel/archive/annual_panel_raw.csv (user-supplied, source and units not stated). target = 1 if the firm's default date falls 0-365 days after the statement date (FY end), else 0; rows dated after the firm's default date are dropped (4,399). Then cleaned (A1-A4: dropped FY end after 2025-10-31, non-12-month periods, total assets<=0; blanked codes -9/-8/-7 and impossible cells; n_sentinel_blanked added as a feature) -> annual_panel/annual_panel_clean.csv: 88,229 rows, 9,840 firms, 703 positive rows, 842 defaulting firms. Excluded from features (not financial statements or equal to the outcome): Company Name, Months, Slice, Limits, Category, Onset known, Year basis, the firm-level default flag, Default date. JURISDICTION IN IS PROVISIONAL (inferred from MSME categories; source not stated) - confirm at G0. Open: units; meaning of Slice/Limits/Onset known; defaulters vs non-defaulters cover different calendar windows; no filing-lag buffer; G5 inputs (mandatory field, legal-form gate, override policy) not yet given.
